params.name: ownerId
params.description: The ID of the workspace to return logs for

params.name: startTime
params.description: Epoch/Unix timestamp of start of time range to return. Defaults to `now() - 1 hour`.

params.name: endTime
params.description: Epoch/Unix timestamp of end of time range to return. Defaults to `now()`.

params.name: direction
params.description:
The direction to query logs for. Backward will return most recent logs first.
Forward will start with the oldest logs in the time range.

params.name: resource
params.description: Filter logs by their resource. A resource is the id of a server, cronjob, job, postgres, redis, or workflow.

params.name: instance
params.description: Filter logs by the instance they were emitted from. An instance is the id of a specific running server.

params.name: host
params.description: Filter request logs by their host. [Wildcards and regex](https://render.com/docs/logging#wildcards-and-regular-expressions) are supported.

params.name: statusCode
params.description: Filter request logs by their status code. [Wildcards and regex](https://render.com/docs/logging#wildcards-and-regular-expressions) are supported.

params.name: method
params.description: Filter request logs by their requests method. [Wildcards and regex](https://render.com/docs/logging#wildcards-and-regular-expressions) are supported.

params.name: task
params.description: Filter logs by their task(s)

params.name: taskRun
params.description: Filter logs by their task run id(s)

params.name: level
params.description: Filter logs by their severity level. [Wildcards and regex](https://render.com/docs/logging#wildcards-and-regular-expressions) are supported.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter logs by their type. Types include `app` for application logs, `request` for request logs, and `build` for build logs. You can find the full set of types available for a query by using the `GET /logs/values` endpoint.

params.name: text
params.description: Filter by the text of the logs. [Wildcards and regex](https://render.com/docs/logging#wildcards-and-regular-expressions) are supported.

params.name: path
params.description: Filter request logs by their path. [Wildcards and regex](https://render.com/docs/logging#wildcards-and-regular-expressions) are supported.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

items.docs:
List logs matching the provided filters. Logs are paginated by start and end timestamps.
There are more logs to fetch if `hasMore` is true in the response. Provide the `nextStartTime`
and `nextEndTime` timestamps as the `startTime` and `endTime` query parameters to fetch the next page of logs.

You can query for logs across multiple resources, but all resources must be in the same region and belong to the same owner.

Open a websocket connection to subscribe to logs matching the provided filters. Logs are streamed in real-time as they are generated.

You can query for logs across multiple resources, but all resources must be in the same region and belong to the same owner.
